verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments infrastructure platform, so data region or residency choice is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any option to select a data storage region. The only storage-related mention is physical storage of unnamed card batches at a logistics partner, which is not data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
